name: rayfold-apps
description: A fleet of Rayfold microservices and the micro-frontends that use them, built the way a real team would.

scripts.schema:check: rayfold check services/documents/src/documents.rayfold --against services/documents/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/workspace/src/workspace.rayfold --against services/workspace/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/catalogue/src/catalogue.rayfold --against services/catalogue/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/feedback/src/feedback.rayfold --against services/feedback/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/approvals/src/main/resources/approvals.rayfold --against services/approvals/rayfold.lock.json
scripts.schema:lock: rayfold lock services/documents/src/documents.rayfold --out services/documents/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/workspace/src/workspace.rayfold --out services/workspace/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/catalogue/src/catalogue.rayfold --out services/catalogue/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/feedback/src/feedback.rayfold --out services/feedback/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/approvals/src/main/resources/approvals.rayfold --out services/approvals/rayfold.lock.json
scripts.schema:types: rayfold gen ts services/catalogue/src/catalogue.rayfold --out web/help/src/gen/catalogue.ts && rayfold gen ts services/feedback/src/feedback.rayfold --out web/help/src/gen/feedback.ts && rayfold gen kotlin services/approvals/src/main/resources/approvals.rayfold --package keel.signoff.api --out clients/signoff/src/main/kotlin/keel/signoff/api/Approvals.kt
